title: WithThinking unwrap required in query_agent.rs violates qualitative spec constraint
description: The moeb.reasoning-reviewer spec's qualitative rubric states the WithThinking variant must not be referenced outside adapters/mod.rs, adapters/anthropic.rs, and the single unwrap arm in agent_inner.rs. However, query_agent.rs also calls adapter.send() directly and must handle WithThinking for Rust exhaustive match compliance. A pre-unwrap arm was added to query_agent.rs, technically violating the qualitative constraint. The spec did not account for other files that call adapter.send() directly.
proposed_resolution: Update the moeb.reasoning-reviewer spec's qualitative criterion to include query_agent.rs in the list of permissible WithThinking references, or route query_agent.rs through a shared unwrap helper in adapters/mod.rs so all WithThinking handling is centralized in one place.
